title: Taiwan Quantum Computing Group Hosts Finance Debate
excerpt: TAQCIT will host a debate on the urgency of preparing for quantum finance, with a speaker stating, “Financial institutions should immediately prioritize the migration to cryptography (PQC).”
content:
TAQCIT will host a debate on the urgent need for financial institutions to prepare for quantum computing threats at CellWine Saloon in Taipei City on December 15, 2026. The event, Night of Debate 02, will bring together individuals interested in finance, cybersecurity and quantum technology to discuss whether a proactive or staged approach to post-quantum cryptography is best.

According to TAQCIT, financial institutions should immediately prioritize the migration to post-quantum cryptography (PQC), as asset inventory, testing, and supply chain adjustments require significant time and resources. Early bird tickets costing NT$1,200 are available until 23:59 on November 20.

TAQCIT Salon Focus: Prioritizing Migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography

The event, Night of Debate 02, acknowledges that immediate action requires more than just technical solutions, demanding a reallocation of budgets and personnel. TAQCIT states that inventory of cryptographic assets, system testing, supply chain collaboration, and cryptographic agility all take time, but prioritizing immediately also means that organizations must reallocate budgets, manpower and execution order, the company says. The discussion will center on whether a rapid, full-scale migration is preferable to a phased approach based on assessed risk and available resources.

TAQCIT specifically invites individuals involved in finance, cybersecurity, compliance, risk governance and quantum technology to attend, listen to diverse viewpoints, and formulate their own conclusions. Each ticket includes one glass of wine or sparkling water, alongside unlimited soft drinks, encouraging in-person engagement with the complex challenges of quantum-resistant security.
